references.text: The prohibition against lying with your neighbor's wife extends adultery to include sexual sin with a married woman.
The penalty for adultery is set: both the man and the woman shall die.
Repetition of the sixth commandment in Deuteronomy, confirming the prohibition against adultery.
Elaborated law on the punishment for a man who lies with a married woman.
Proverbs describe that whoever commits adultery lacks understanding and destroys their own soul.
The prophet Jeremiah mentions adultery among the sins God will testify against.
Hosea lists adultery as one of the sins that fill the land.
Jesus elaborates on the commandment, teaching that even a lustful look at a woman is adultery in the heart.
Jesus quotes the commandment against adultery when answering the rich young man.
Jesus mentions the commandment against adultery in his conversation with the rich man.
Luke's account where Jesus quotes the commandment against adultery.
Paul quotes the commandment against adultery and summarizes that love fulfills the law.
James quotes the commandment against adultery to show that the unity of the law is broken by a single violation.
Jesus' direct quote that introduces a theological deepening of the true meaning of the commandment.
